            <link>https://www.pbs.org/newshour/world/how-alberta-separatism-went-from-fringe-cause-to-referendum</link>

            <link>https://www.pbs.org/newshour/show/oregon-school-shooter-attacked-special-education-classroom-police-say</link>
            <description><![CDATA[Police in Bend, Oregon, are still investigating the motive behind the deadly shooting at Silver Rail Elementary School. Four people were killed, including three young children and a teacher. Police identified the shooter as a 16-year-old who previously attended the school.             <description><![CDATA[There are many more questions to be answered about the deadly elementary school shooting in Bend, Oregon.             <link>https://www.pbs.org/newshour/show/news-wrap-zacharia-out-as-white-house-press-secretary-after-less-than-a-week-on-the-job</link>
            <description><![CDATA[In our news wrap Friday, White House Press Secretary Katie Zacharia is "transitioning out" of her role after less than a week on the job, three large brush fires in Southern California are forcing people to flee their homes and dozens of Israeli settlers set cars and trees ablaze across the West Bank and attacked Palestinians as they gathered for their autumn olive harvest.]]></description>

            <title><![CDATA[Kerry Kennedy remembers her mother's life and advocacy in new book]]></title>
            <link>https://www.pbs.org/newshour/show/kerry-kennedy-remembers-her-mothers-life-and-advocacy-in-new-book</link>
            <description><![CDATA[Two years ago, Ethel Kennedy passed away. The matriarch of the prominent political dynasty, she was a steadfast supporter of her husband, Robert F. Kennedy, and a lifelong advocate for human rights. She's now being remembered in a new book by her daughter called "Ethel Kennedy: The Extraordinary Life and Bold Legacy." Amna Nawaz sat down with Kerry Kennedy to discuss more. ]]></description>
